# Written from docs/research/unit-464dir-2026-11-02/spans.12.closure.txt (drive2) — the predicate
# sliced from rev b0de039bd79f3fa30daba69353d2eeaf48c42a2e, plus every same-file declaration of
# every identifier the predicate names, which drive2 prints. Written BEFORE grade-direction.mjs
# existed.
# His subkind is NOT retyped here. The grader joins these rows onto
# unit-464class-2026-11-02/HAND-READ.tsv on (file, line, id) and lifts his column itself, so a
# departure cannot be manufactured by my transcription of his verdict.
# direction — what the predicate ASSERTS about the two states it reads:
#   delta        the frozen figure and the live figure are asserted to DIFFER
#   keyed        the frozen figure and the live figure are asserted to AGREE
#   conjunctive  NEITHER — two independent single-state assertions, each against a LITERAL, with
#                no comparison between the states. A cure moves one conjunct, not the relation.
#   staleness    neither side is the live subject; the assertion is about whether a PIN is current
# reach — can a correct cure of the defect this harness grades move the figure compared?
#   reachable | inert
# frozen-addressing — how the non-live side is named:
#   literal          a 40/8-hex sha written in the source, or a literal path
#   event-anchored   computed, but anchored on an event so new commits cannot move it
#   recency          `git log -1` — moves whenever anything touches the path
#   artefact         a committed recording read as a file
